adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then does `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), ...)`. A template literal always returns a (non-empty) string even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined` and/or `t(err.message)` resolves to something unhelpful, so the fallback `unable_to_add_guests` is effectively dead code. This also risks surfacing raw/internal error text via `err.message` (e.g., TRPC INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR messages) directly to users, as the diff shows no sanitization/mapping of errors.
